description: This Java class 'PojoJavaCodeProducer' is responsible for generating Java code for POJOs and Enums within a code generation framework. It processes wrappers representing data structures and produces corresponding Java classes and enums using templates. The class handles assigning file names, packages, and managing dependencies among generated classes.

classes.name: PojoJavaCodeProducer
classes.description: A code producer class responsible for generating Java POJO and Enum source files from data wrappers.

methods.name: generate()
methods.description: Main method to generate Java code files for POJOs and Enums by processing wrappers.

methods.name: generateWrapperFile()
methods.description: Generates a Java source file for a given wrapper object and writes to disk.

methods.name: generateWrapperBuffer()
methods.description: Creates the Java source code content as a string buffer for a specific wrapper.

methods.name: assignNames()
methods.description: Assigns class, package, and filename properties to wrappers based on context.
